```sql
with per_order as (
    select o.order_id,
           count(a.attempt_id) as attempts
    from orders o
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    left join payment_attempts a
      on a.order_id = o.order_id
     and not a.is_test
    where not o.is_test
      and s.country_code = 'IN'
    group by o.order_id
)
select cast(NULL as varchar) as key,
       cast(avg(attempts) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from per_order
order by value
```
